title: Station Zero voice script, wave 1: the Voice of the Rapid (ZERO), Strand, the Night Inspector, the Conductor, the four heroes

canon.source: docs/station-zero/01-LORE.md wins over everything here; slots and IDs follow 11-AUDIO-DIRECTION.md section 5 (V01-V50, P1-P8, tapes 1-8, C1-C3, booth, phones, heroes 40 each)
canon.zero: ZERO (Zone Electronic Routing Operator) has no voice of its own. It speaks through the departure board, lamps, printers and the recorded Voice of the Rapid (Evelyn Marsh, 1984), which it assembles word by word. A line with recorded=false is a sentence she never said: ZERO stitched it, and one seam is audible.
canon.names: Every name is the bible's own (Port Halcyon, Halcyon Rapid Transit, Lodestar Signal & Telephone, the Zero Line). The brief's "Group 935" and "Parisian" setting are not used: 01-LORE forbids names from other games and places the map in Port Halcyon; Lodestar is the corporation that knew. The French lines are a localisation for the French-speaking servers, not a change of setting.

owner_decisions: Hero voices (11-AUDIO-DIRECTION 5.7): route (b), new voices for the 1986 film roles, is what this script is written for. Cloning or imitating the base-game actors from game audio is not done.
French: generate with the same designed voice (multilingual model) or design a French voice per speaker; default here: the same voice.
The setting stays Port Halcyon (canon). A Paris setting would be a new bible, not a wave of this one.

generation.voices: voice_id stays null until a voice is designed (creative_design_voice with the speaker's voice_design_prompt and one of its lines) and saved, or picked from creative_list_voices; never a remembered id

lines.speaker: STR
lines.when: 14 April 1983; found in the Cordon, the Channel 9 van
lines.en: Tape one. Strand, Lodestar, Station Zero site office. The Zero Line opens next New Year's Eve, driverless, and the bypass is the bottleneck. Cheapest route cuts through an arch the 1931 surveyors marked old sewer, bricked and never opened. If it holds, we save eleven months. I asked for the drawings. Told asking is a formality.
lines.fr: Cassette une. Strand, Lodestar, chantier Station Zéro. La ligne Zéro ouvre au prochain réveillon, sans conducteurs, et la dérivation bloque tout. Le tracé le moins cher passe par une voûte notée « ancien égout » en 1931, murée et jamais ouverte. Si elle tient, on gagne onze mois. J'ai demandé les plans. Une formalité, paraît-il.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.when: 17 August 1983; found in the Arcade, Hole Number Nine
lines.en: Tape two. We broke through this morning. Behind the brick sits a salon: parquet, gas chandeliers, a wall of tuning forks in walnut. Halcyon Atmospheric ran pneumatic mail here from 1893, and in 1897 sent live riders in capsules. Its founder, Ambrose Vayle, left notebooks. He tuned the main like an organ pipe, to send riders where the dead go and bring them back. His words. I felt the note in my teeth.
lines.fr: Cassette deux. On a percé ce matin. Derrière la brique, un salon : parquet, lustres à gaz, tout un mur de diapasons en noyer. La Halcyon Atmospheric exploitait ici une poste pneumatique dès 1893, et en 1897 y a envoyé des passagers en capsules. Son fondateur, Ambrose Vayle, a laissé des carnets : il a accordé la conduite comme un orgue, pour envoyer des gens chez les morts et les ramener. Je cite. J'ai senti la note dans mes dents.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.when: 12 October 1983; found in the Transit Police Post, an evidence tag
lines.en: Tape three. Test trolley, six volunteers, Carrier on. All six logged the same thing: they arrived before they left. One wrote his arrival time, then an earlier departure, without blinking. I sent a memo. Lodestar filed it under 'anecdotal.' Six signed forms are not an anecdote.
lines.fr: Cassette trois. Draisine d'essai, six volontaires, Porteuse active. Tous ont noté pareil : arrivés avant de partir. L'un a écrit son arrivée, puis un départ antérieur, sans tiquer. J'ai envoyé une note. Lodestar l'a classée « anecdotique ». Six fiches signées ne sont pas une anecdote.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.when: 20 February 1984; found in Platform A East, a seat of car 2
lines.en: Tape four. The Carrier is a tone in the rails so ZERO tracks its trains. In the old tube it comes back—not an echo, an answer, on Vayle's note. Two signals agreeing. On a moving train, I can't say where it goes. Only that it goes first, and returns. I warned them. They kept the bypass.
lines.fr: Cassette quatre. La Porteuse, c'est un signal dans les rails pour que ZERO suive ses trains. Dans l'ancien tube, il revient — pas en écho, en réponse, sur la note de Vayle. Deux signaux qui s'accordent. Sur un train lancé, j'ignore où ça mène. Ça part ailleurs, puis ça revient. Je les ai prévenus. Ils gardent la dérivation.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.when: 9 August 1984; found in the Car Barn
lines.en: Tape five. Cars are fitted: receivers, door sensors, a lamp-proving current glowing amber. Inaugural run's announced: six cars, three hundred twelve guests, a thirteen-minute loop, home at midnight sharp. The press loves 'sharp.' I stopped saying what the loop crosses. They only ask if we're on schedule.
lines.fr: Cassette cinq. Voitures équipées : récepteurs, capteurs de portes, courant ambre. Trajet inaugural annoncé : six voitures, trois cent douze invités, boucle de treize minutes, retour à minuit pile. La presse adore « pile ». J'ai arrêté de dire ce qu'on traverse. Ils demandent juste si on sera à l'heure.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.en: Tape six. Tonight I read ZERO's log spec to the end. A run is pending or arrived. No third state. The contract promised zero failed runs, and the coders took that as physics instead of policy. If 047 never arrives, ZERO holds it pending and calls the departure again, and again, while power lasts.
lines.fr: Cassette six. Ce soir j'ai fini le cahier des charges de ZERO. Un trajet est en attente ou arrivé. Pas de troisième état. Le contrat promettait zéro échec ; les programmeurs l'ont pris au pied de la lettre. Si le 047 ne revient pas, ZERO rappellera le départ, encore et encore, tant qu'il aura du jus.

lines.speaker: STR
lines.en: Tape seven. [sighs] I asked the chairman to postpone. He said a railway never late can't start late. I asked Lodestar for grounds to refuse and got a ribbon. So I'll ride the cab, hand on the controller. If I'm right, they'll still be on that platform, listening to the PA. Please find these.
lines.fr: Cassette sept. [sighs] J'ai demandé au président de reporter. Un train jamais en retard ne peut pas partir en retard, qu'il m'a dit. Lodestar m'a répondu par un ruban. Alors je monte en cabine, main sur le levier. Si j'ai raison, ils seront encore sur ce quai à écouter l'annonce. Trouvez ces cassettes.
